About Star Wok Asian Bistro

Star Wok Asian Bistro is a casual, welcoming spot located at 5810 East Sam Houston Pkwy N Suite G, Houston, TX 77049, making it an easy stop for locals and anyone passing through the area looking for reliable Asian comfort food. When introducing this place to friends, I often mention how popular it is for lunch, especially because the lunch specials strike a great balance between value and portion size. One standout option that frequently gets attention is the Amazing Chicken lunch special, which is affordably priced and comes with thoughtful choices that let diners customize their meal, such as selecting between an egg roll or crab puffs along with soup, something that adds variety and makes each visit feel slightly different. The kitchen is known for working quickly, so meals arrive hot and fresh without a long wait, which is ideal for people on a lunch break or anyone wanting a satisfying meal without lingering too long. The flavors are approachable and comforting, with dishes like wonton soup offering a pleasantly mild, savory taste that pairs well with classic fried rice, both of which are often enjoyed as dependable go-to options. Portions are filling without being overwhelming, making it easy to enjoy a complete meal without feeling overly heavy afterward. While most of the menu earns praise for taste and consistency, some items stand out more than others, encouraging guests to explore the core dishes rather than everything on the menu at once. Overall, Star Wok Asian Bistro has built a reputation as a place people return to regularly because it delivers quick service, solid flavors, and lunch options that feel thoughtfully put together, creating an experience that feels familiar, convenient, and satisfying each time you walk through the door.

“ This lunch special was called Amazing chicken only 8.99 and this is the first place I've ever been to where you have a choice to get an egg roll or crab Puffs and of course the soup love your choice. ”

Theresa Prado

“ The food here is so delicious I highly recommend it . Every time I come in the ladies are so sweet .the food is delicious. You must come by and give them a try .and lunch specials are a great deal . ”

Kenneth Brodersen

“ I always enjoy coming here. The food it’s delicious and quick. The lunch menu is the perfect amount of food. You need to try this place at least once. ”

The New Old Man Cowen

“ Shrimp fried rice has only 10 shrimps, but they are big. We order the same thing every week, sometimes the chicken wing gets small, they usually put one or two extras in. We live nearby, food is always ready when we arrived. Very fresh ”

“ I have never try the wonton soup and it was good, the fried rice was also good! Only thing that I didn't like at all and will never buy are the wings! They looked old and dry! ”

Claudia Garcia
